record.paper_title: THE LYAPIN’S NOTEBOOK: A COLLECTION OF UNSOLVED PROBLEMS IN SEMIGROUP THEORY
record.context_brief: Elementary inclusive varieties from finite members
record.original_question: Determine whether there exists a variety of semigroups such that the class of its finite semigroups, or of its finitely generated semigroups, forms an elementary inclusive variety.

evidence.quote:
Problem 6.8. (G. Mashevitzky) Does there exist a variety of semigroups such that the class of its
finite (or finitely generated) semigroups forms an elementary inclusive variety?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the signature of semigroups (a single binary associative operation). A class K of semigroups is called an inclusive variety if it is closed under taking subsemigroups, homomorphic images, and arbitrary direct products. An inclusive variety is called elementary if it can be axiomatized by a set of first-order sentences in the language of semigroups. A variety of semigroups is, as usual, a class defined by a set of identities (which is automatically an inclusive variety).

For a semigroup variety V, let V_fin denote the class of all finite members of V, and let V_fg denote the class of all finitely generated members of V.

Question: Does there exist a variety V of semigroups such that V_fin is an elementary inclusive variety? Equivalently (as a parallel question), does there exist a variety V of semigroups such that V_fg is an elementary inclusive variety?
artifact.status_search_result: A 2025 paper in Algebra Universalis by Mashevitzky establishes that many natural classes (finite groups, p-groups, Engel groups, solvable groups, nilsemigroups, nilpotent semigroups, periodic Clifford semigroups) are nonelementary inclusive varieties, showing such classes are typically nonelementary. However, no source found explicitly settles whether some variety of semigroups exists whose class of finite (or finitely generated) members is an elementary inclusive variety. Status appears unresolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Nonelementary inclusive varieties of groups and semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies nonelementary inclusive varieties of groups, Clifford semigroups and nilsemigroups; many natural classes are shown to be nonelementary inclusive varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Provides nonelementary results for many classes but does not establish existence of a variety whose finite or finitely generated members form an elementary inclusive variety.

status_evidence.title: Elementary and non-elementary inclusive varieties — BIU Math seminar
status_evidence.snippet: Many basic classes (finite groups, p-groups, nilsemigroups, periodic Clifford semigroups) are non-elementary inclusive varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Talk discusses the framework but does not record a resolution of the existence question for finite or finitely generated members of a semigroup variety.
